    vd ⊢ |={⊤}=> backend.cachedAt γ ver idx ∗ ghostVar γ.cur r ((ver, idx), win) ∗ backend.bView γ q

    = none) : backend.curAt tx es n k v ⊢ ⌜k = slice.nil ∧ v = slice.nil⌝

def backend.bktFact (rtx : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (n : GoString) (bk : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜D !! n = none ∧ bk = null⌝ ∨ ∃ m, ⌜D !! n = some m ∧ bk ≠ null⌝ ∗ backend.rBkt rtx bk (backend.bktEnts m))

    (nk : GoString × GoString) : backend.vData P (C', X) !! nk = backend.vData P (C, X) !! nk ∨
    backend.vData P (C', X) !! nk = backend.vData P (C', R.reset) !! nk

    backend.Data) (X R : backend.RBuf) (L : backend.VData) : backend.thinV γ (backend.vData P (C,

theorem backend.single_sorted (es : List backend.Ent) (kb : GoString) (h : backend.entsSorted es) :
    (match List.dropWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst kb)) es with | [] => [] | e :: tail
    => if e.fst = kb then [e] else []) = match backend.lastVal es kb with | some v => [(kb, v)] |
    none => []

    backend.keyLe k (v, i + 1)

    (kb : GoString) (limit : w64) (hb : P.has bi) (hR : rv.snd.Wf) : backend.rtRange rv bi kb []
    limit = match backend.vOf P rv bi.name kb with | some v => [(kb, v)] | none => []
